newsitem.title: USA: InterAmericas names Carlos Menendez CFO.
newsitem.headline: InterAmericas names Carlos Menendez CFO.

text.p: Telecommunications service provider InterAmericas Communications Corp said on Monday it named Carlos Menendez as chief operating officer and chief financial officer.
Menendez was an international executive for Merck & Co for 15 years, the company said in a statement.
Chief Executive Officer Hernan Streeter had been acting CFO and COO, the company said.

InterAmericas said Menendez's international management skills would help the company integrate and expand its operations in Chile and Peru. He would also assist the company in its planned integration of Conecel S.A., Ecuador's leading cellular services provider.
At Merck, Menendez was most recently vice president of the $300 million Kelco Co subsidiary, where he was responsible for all staff functions.
